family: The single total input-prefix family F defined in proof.md: F_0=0; for N>=1 let B be the least integer with B^5>32*N^3 and k the least prime >=B; if k>=N output 0; else read the first k bits as the lower coefficients of a monic degree-k polynomial Q over F_2, output 0 unless Q is irreducible (prime-degree test of proof.md Section 2); put m=N-k, r=ceil(m/k), t=ceil(sqrt(r)); zero-pad the last m bits into r blocks u_i in K=F_2[Z]/(Q), set y_i=u_i^(2^(r+2-i)-1), and output Tr_K(E_t(y_1,...,y_r)), the trace of the t-th elementary symmetric polynomial. One fixed evaluator defines every length.
theorem: For this one total uniform polynomial-time family, hence in NP with empty witnesses, C_B2(F_N)>=(7/2)*N-120*N^(4/5) for every integer N>=2^22, hence liminf C_B2(F_N)/N>=7/2 at actual input length N in the full Li-Yang B2 model.
